architecture: MobileNetV3-small ImageNet1kV1; frozen features[0:9]; trainable features[9:]; global+skin-weighted pooling 1152->128 ReLU LayerNorm; scalar ordinal score + 9 ordered thresholds
initialization: torch.manual_seed(17); torchvision default random initialization then official backbone state; thresholds -2 + k*0.5
normalization: RGB/255; fixed ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406], std [0.229,0.224,0.225]. No per-image color normalization. Fold-only initial-embedding/target population mean/std, clamp std 1e-6.
input: STW: YuNet eye alignment of supplied face crop; EasyPortrait face parsing skin=1; RGB128 bilinear, mask128 nearest. MSKCC: central 80% clinical image crop, RGB128 bilinear, all-one mask; no facial parser.
augmentation: none; different same-source same-group TRAIN captures are real paired views, not independently labelled new images
determinism: CPU float32, torch deterministic algorithms, 2 intraop/1 interop threads; explicit torch generators; no stochastic NumPy/Python operations
batchnorm: running means/variances frozen; tail affine parameters trainable; prefix always eval and no gradients
optimizer: AdamW betas [0.9,0.999], eps 1e-8, foreach=false; fresh per experiment/fold; all states persisted on resume

pretrain.loss: mean BCE for 9 cumulative MST thresholds on both views; C adds mean (1-cosine) for different frames of known groups
pretrain.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR T_max=12, step after each epoch
pretrain.selection: fixed final epoch12; no early stopping

transfer.loss: MSE standardized native instrument Lab D65/10deg
transfer.head: Linear(128,64)->ReLU->Linear(64,3)
transfer.roles: exact C_REBASE_V1 966 TRAIN rows /24 people /6 saved folds; no other MSKCC roles

comparison.promotion: paired mean DeltaE candidate-minus-comparator 95% CI strictly below0 AND lower median AND lower p95; C also must pass against B
comparison.mst_selection: validation equal-group MAE then within-one then B; useful only if MAE >=0.1 below TRAIN-group-median constant predictor; freeze before test
